description: How a project keeps its issues' statuses in step with its own Jira (see get_jira_link): 'direction' — 'off', 'both', 'from_jira' (Jira moves, the issue here follows) or 'to_jira' (the issue here moves, Jira follows); 'pairs' — which status here is which there, in order; 'actsFor' — the person whose name a move made here carries, and 'ownerStands' false when they can no longer be acted for (the sync then waits until somebody saves it again); 'webhook' — whether the site's webhook is set up and when it was last heard (the address itself is only shown on the screen); 'statuses' here and 'jiraStatuses' there to pair; and the issues left with their statuses apart, with why ('conflict', 'no_pair_here', 'no_pair_there', 'refused_here', 'no_move', 'refused_there', 'missing', 'token'). For whoever administers the project.
name: get_jira_sync
